section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports one study (Study X) validating a Brazilian Portuguese translation of the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS) with 194 Brazilian university women. Participants completed the BSRS and measures including body appreciation and had bra size and BMI objectively measured; results showed breast size dissatisfaction was common and associated with higher BMI and lower body appreciation.
section_summary.evidence_source: Text: "The present study examined the psychometric properties of a Brazilian Portuguese translation of the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS). A total of 194 Brazilian university women completed the BSRS... They also had their actual bra size and body mass indices (BMIs) objectively measured. Results indicated... higher BMI, lower body appreciation... Findings demonstrate that BSRS scores are psychometrically sound and that breast size dissatisfaction is common among Brazilian women."
